description: This is a shell script that functions as a test suite for the 'git restore' command. It sets up a git repository, makes various commits, performs restore operations under different conditions, and verifies the correctness of each operation through assertions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the given command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test completes for cleanup.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Ensures the given file or output is empty.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
